name: grenier
title: grenier — declutter & resell
description: A collection of Claude Skills to sort your home and turn clutter into things sold, donated or recycled. English core, local marketplace recipes per country. Open source.

skills.name: declutter
skills.title: Sorting coach
skills.description: Coaches you step by step to declutter: one zone, one short slot, four destinations, zero 'maybe'.

skills.name: offload
skills.title: Offload — what to do with it
skills.description: For an item to deal with: sell (and where), donate, recycle or trash — value/effort trade-off and channels for your country.

skills.name: sell
skills.title: Sell — draft the listing
skills.description: From a photo or description to a ready-to-post listing: identification, price, platform, title and description, tuned to your country.
